Improve car-bidding-arena-arena-ui-design-system based on usage findings.
  Finding 1: FormField crashes the whole React tree when composed with children (e.g. <FormField id="x" label="y"><Input/></FormField>). FormFieldProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'id'>, so children is permitted by the type system and the usage type-checks under strict mode, but FormField spreads ...inputProps (which includes children) onto its internal <Input>, which renders <input {...rest}> and React throws an uncaught "input is a void element tag and must neither have children" error that unmounts the consumer's entire app. The library's own tests/demo only use the self-contained form (<FormField id label placeholder ... />), but that distinction is invisible in the types, so the most natural composition pattern compiles fine and then crashes at runtime. at [frontend/src/components/FormField.tsx, frontend/src/components/Input.tsx, frontend/dist-lib/index.js] — Observed while testing scenario s1 in a fresh consumer app: the page rendered nothing and the browser console showed React error #137 plus 'input is a void element tag and must neither have children' originating inside dist-lib/index.js (Input/FormField).

rationale: it's a continuation fixing design project but it's wrong using frontend, should be design project from the beginning
